_original_lore: since the beginning, wisps were once
famously used to light the way down
in the darkest depths. This one
seems to have been stuck in a
broken lantern for a long, long time.
name: 笼中灵光

source: since the beginning, wisps were once
famously used to light the way down
in the darkest depths. This one
seems to have been stuck in a
broken lantern for a long, long time.
loreParagraphs.translation: 灵光自古以来就是矮人忠实的伙伴,曾以在最幽深的黑暗中照亮前路而闻名.这一只似乎被困在破灯笼里很久很久了.
